mapper.select: select room_id as roomId, member_id as memberId, title, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from ai_chat_room where member_id = #{memberId} order by created_at desc limit 1

select message_id as messageId, room_id as roomId, sender_type as senderType, message, created_at as createdAt from ( select message_id, room_id, sender_type, message, created_at from ai_chat_message where room_id = #{roomId} order by message_id desc limit 20 ) recent_message order by message_id asc

select message_id as messageId, room_id as roomId, sender_type as senderType, message, created_at as createdAt from ( select message_id, room_id, sender_type, message, created_at from ai_chat_message where room_id = #{roomId} order by message_id desc limit 10 ) recent_message order by message_id asc

select cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as address
, c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , c.status as status
, vm.manufacturer as manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.connector_type as vehicleConnectorType
, round((ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) / 1000)::numeric, 2) as distanceKm
from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = v.member_id join charging_station cs on ST_DWithin(cs.location, sl.location, 30000) join charger c on c.station_id = cs.station_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_default = true and v.is_deleted = false and sl.is_default = true and cs.station_status = '운영중' and c.status = '사용가능' and replace(trim(c.connector_type), ' ', '') = replace(trim(vm.connector_type), ' ', '') order by case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 when c.status = '예약중' then 2 when c.status = '사용중' then 3 else 4 end , distanceKm asc , c.charging_speed_kw desc limit 5

select vm.manufacturer as manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.battery_capacity_kwh as batteryCapacityKwh , vm.connector_type as vehicleConnectorType
, cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as stationAddress
, c.charger_id as chargerId , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , c.connector_type as chargerConnectorType
, round((ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) / 1000)::numeric, 2) as distanceKm
from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = v.member_id join charging_station cs on ST_DWithin(cs.location, sl.location, 30000) join charger c on c.station_id = cs.station_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_default = true and v.is_deleted = false and sl.is_default = true and cs.station_status = '운영중' and c.status = '사용가능' and replace(trim(c.connector_type), ' ', '') = replace(trim(vm.connector_type), ' ', '') order by case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 when c.status = '예약중' then 2 when c.status = '사용중' then 3 else 4 end , ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) asc , c.charging_speed_kw desc limit 1

select location_id as locationId , location_name as locationName , location_type as locationType , address , latitude , longitude , is_default as isDefault from saved_location where member_id = #{memberId} and is_default = true order by location_id asc limit 1

with user_context as ( select v.vehicle_id , v.vehicle_nickname , vm.manufacturer , vm.model_name , vm.battery_capacity_kwh , vm.connector_type as vehicle_connector_type , vm.max_charging_speed_kw , sl.location_id , sl.location_name , sl.address as location_address , sl.latitude as location_latitude , sl.longitude as location_longitude , sl.location from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = v.member_id and sl.is_default = true where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_default = true and coalesce(v.is_deleted, false) = false order by v.vehicle_id asc limit 1 ), base_candidate as ( select uc.vehicle_id , uc.vehicle_nickname , uc.manufacturer , uc.model_name , uc.battery_capacity_kwh , uc.vehicle_connector_type , uc.max_charging_speed_kw , uc.location_id , uc.location_name , uc.location_address , uc.location_latitude , uc.location_longitude , cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.operator_name , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , c.charger_id , c.charger_name , c.charger_type , c.connector_type , c.charging_speed_kw , c.price_per_kwh , c.status , round((ST_Distance(cs.location, uc.location) / 1000)::numeric, 2)::double precision as distance_km , least( c.charging_speed_kw, coalesce(nullif(uc.max_charging_speed_kw, 0), c.charging_speed_kw) )::double precision as effective_charging_speed_kw , round( (uc.battery_capacity_kwh * ((#{targetSoc} - #{currentSoc}) / 100.0))::numeric, 2 )::double precision as required_kwh from user_context uc join charging_station cs on ST_DWithin(cs.location, uc.location, #{radiusMeter}) join charger c on c.station_id = cs.station_id where cs.station_status = '운영중' and coalesce(cs.is_deleted, false) = false and c.status = '사용가능' and coalesce(c.is_deleted, false) = false and replace(upper(trim(c.connector_type)), ' ', '') = replace(upper(trim(uc.vehicle_connector_type)), ' ', '') ), estimated_candidate as ( select bc.* , greatest( 10, ceil((bc.required_kwh / nullif(bc.effective_charging_speed_kw, 0)) * 60 * 1.15)::int ) as estimated_minutes , round((bc.required_kwh * bc.price_per_kwh)::numeric, 0)::double precision as estimated_cost from base_candidate bc where bc.required_kwh > 0 and bc.effective_charging_speed_kw > 0 ) select row_number() over () as candidateNo , ec.vehicle_id as vehicleId , ec.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , ec.manufacturer , ec.model_name as modelName , ec.battery_capacity_kwh as batteryCapacityKwh , ec.vehicle_connector_type as vehicleConnectorType , ec.max_charging_speed_kw as maxChargingSpeedKw , ec.location_id as locationId , ec.location_name as locationName , ec.location_address as locationAddress , ec.location_latitude as locationLatitude , ec.location_longitude as locationLongitude , ec.station_id as stationId , ec.station_name as stationName , ec.address , ec.operator_name as operatorName , ec.latitude , ec.longitude , ec.distance_km as distanceKm , ec.charger_id as chargerId , ec.charger_name as chargerName , ec.charger_type as chargerType , ec.connector_type as connectorType , ec.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , ec.effective_charging_speed_kw as effectiveChargingSpeedKw , ec.price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , ec.status , ec.required_kwh as requiredKwh , ec.estimated_minutes as estimatedMinutes , ec.estimated_cost as estimatedCost from estimated_candidate ec where not exists ( select 1 from reservation r where r.charger_id = ec.charger_id and r.status in ('예약완료', '인증완료', '충전중') and #{startTime}::timestamp < r.end_time and (#{startTime}::timestamp + (ec.estimated_minutes * interval '1 minute')) > r.start_time ) order by
ec.price_per_kwh asc , ec.distance_km asc , ec.effective_charging_speed_kw desc
ec.effective_charging_speed_kw desc , ec.distance_km asc , ec.price_per_kwh asc
ec.distance_km asc , ec.effective_charging_speed_kw desc , ec.price_per_kwh asc
limit #{limit}

select r.reservation_id as reservationId , r.reservation_date as reservationDate , to_char(r.start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as startTime , to_char(r.end_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as endTime , r.current_soc as currentSoc , r.target_soc as targetSoc , r.required_kwh as requiredKwh , r.estimated_minutes as estimatedMinutes , r.estimated_cost as estimatedCost , r.status , cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as stationAddress , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , c.charger_id as chargerId , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName from reservation r join charger c on r.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station cs on c.station_id = cs.station_id left join vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id left join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id where r.member_id = #{memberId} order by r.start_time desc limit #{limit}
